total_model.summary: Model projects 50.3 total points (SF 31, WAS 19). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 2.5), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 2.0), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (lowers total 1.1). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
